opening.argument: The presentation promotes adding value to a smart contract as a way to earn income, then presents a claimed withdrawal and remaining balance as evidence that the activity produces returns. It directly urges viewers to participate, saying, "I would like to tell you just start and earn," while supplying a link for participation. Those elements establish a solicitation to put ETH into the Forsage service for investment-style returns, supported by an income demonstration rather than a neutral explanation of Ethereum transactions.
